name: pembuat-blueprint-profesional
title_zh: 访谈问完就出两份蓝图：给 AI 看的和给客户签的
tagline_zh: 需求散在聊天记录里，AI 写代码时全靠猜。它用一轮结构化访谈把 BRD/PRD/SRS 一次问全。
tagline_en: Requirements scattered across chats leave your coding agent guessing. One structured BRD/PRD/SRS interview yields.
desc_en: Memandu wawancara terstruktur (mencakup materi BRD/Business Requirements, PRD/Product Requirements, dan SRS/Software Requirements) untuk menyusun dua dokumen akhir: Blueprint.md — rujukan teknis tunggal untuk vibe coding / agentic coding di Google Antigravity 2.0 — dan Dokumen Blueprint resmi (Google Docs / .docx) yang mengikat secara formal antara client dan developer. Dilengkapi pre-flight check
why_zh: 它把「技术参考」和「合同附件」拆成两份产物：前者给 agent 读，后者给客户签。
why_en: It splits output in two: a machine-readable spec for the agent and a formal doc for the client. A pre-flight check surfaces gaps.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 BRD/PRD/SRS 三类需求文档，UI 稿、排期、报价一律不产出。
limit_en: Covers only BRD/PRD/SRS docs — no UI mockups, schedules, or pricing. Formal blueprint needs Google Docs or .docx export; Markdown-only setups get.
title_en: One interview, two blueprints: one for the AI, one for the.
